title: Book One · Chapter 127: A Name under a Picture
story:
The classroom wall has four street pictures now. One belongs to Mei. One is Ronan's drawing of Mr Qiu. The map has two names under it. The fourth picture shows a food shop near the school.

Ronan likes looking at them before lessons. On Thursday he sees a new line under his own drawing.

THE STALL WE SAVED.

Leo is beside him, holding a piece of chalk.

“It needs a big name,” Leo says.

“We did not save the stall.”

“We saved the books.”

“Some books. And adults moved the table.”

Leo looks at the words. “It will be a very long name if you put all of that.”

Ronan thinks of Mr Qiu reading the first story at the kitchen table. Mr Qiu did not want those words on a wall. Ronan does not want to upset him again.

“We can use his name.”

“That is a person's name. This is a picture name.”

Miss Wu comes in carrying a stack of papers. She sees the boys and the chalk.

“I need the board clean in one minute,” she says. “Whose words are those?”

“Mine,” Leo says.

“Did you both agree?”

“Not yet.”

“Then use the old name for now. You can talk at break.”

She goes to her desk. There is work for the whole class. The boys cannot stand at the wall all morning.

At break Leo writes three names on a loose sheet. THE NEW PLACE. PENCILS IN THE RAIN. MR QIU'S TABLE.

Ronan points to the last one.

“The picture shows a table. This name says that.”

“But it does not tell the story of the rain.”

“The pictures do.”

Mei comes over. She looks at the sheet and then at the wall.

“There is no rain in that picture,” she says.

Leo puts a line through the middle name.

“There was rain before it.”

“Then put it in another picture.”

She goes to wash blue paint from her fingers. Leo watches her leave, then draws a tiny cloud beside the first name. Ronan laughs.

“You can have a cloud. Ask me first. Then we can change my picture name.”

Leo puts the pencil down.

“All right.”

They choose MR QIU'S TABLE and take it to Miss Wu. She reads it while she eats half an orange.

“Please ask Mr Qiu too,” she says.

“Again?” Leo asks.

“The words have changed.”

Leo sits down on the step outside the classroom. He looks at the short list.

“I wanted it to sound good,” he says.

“I know.”

“You could tell me before you look so angry.”

Was his face angry? Ronan did not know. He puts his fingers on his cheeks. Leo laughs and does the same.

“Like this,” he says. He makes his mouth very tight.

Ronan tries it. It feels silly. He lets his mouth go soft again.

“Next time, show me the name first.”

“Next time, tell me before you get so angry.”

They both stand up.

That afternoon they both go. Mr Qiu reads the three names. He likes the last one. He asks them to add one word.

“Small,” he says. “It is a small table.”

Leo writes the word carefully. The name is longer now. It still fits.

On Friday Ronan holds the new title in place. Leo fixes it under the drawing. There is room for both their hands. Afterwards Leo puts the little cloud on his own school bag. He opens his bag and sees the cloud. It makes him smile again.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：agree＝同意；title＝标题；for now＝暂时。

情节提示：chalk＝粉笔；stack＝一叠；cheek＝脸颊。

理解：1. 为什么不能把图叫作“我们救下的摊位”？2. 最后的标题多了哪个词？
